;KISHKOID 512

ampl    EQU   56
spc_tbl EQU   #7000
x_tbl   EQU   #7400
st1     EQU   #1f
st2     EQU   #1
st3     EQU   3
mn1     EQU   #fe;ANG
mn2     EQU   #21;X
mn3     EQU   #fe;LEN

        ORG   #7ffe
        JR    lets_go
sin_ld
start   LOADCODE "SIN_CUT"

lets_go
        EXX
        PUSH  HL

;PREPARE SCREEN
        LD    HL,#5b00
        LD    A,#44
cls     DEC   HL
        LD    (HL),A
        CP    (HL)
        JR    Z,cls

;CREATING SIN TBL
        LD    DE,sin_ld
        LD    H,sin&h
        LD    B,#40
crsin   LD    L,E
        LD    A,(DE)
        LD    C,A
        LD    (HL),C
        LD    A,#80
        SUB   E
        LD    L,A
        LD    (HL),C
        INC   E
        DJNZ  crsin
        DEC   L
        LD    (HL),#fe
        LD    D,H
        LD    E,B
        LD    L,#80
crs1    LD    A,(DE)
        CPL
        LD    (HL),A
        INC   E
        INC   L
        JR    NZ,crs1

;CREATING SPRITES
        LD    HX,15
kd0     LD    DE,ncos
        LD    HL,sin+#40
mdf_sin
        LD    A,(HL)
        RRCA
        AND   #7f
;MLT
        EXX
        SBC   HL,HL
        LD    D,H
        LD    E,A
        LD    A,ampl
        SUB   HX
        SUB   HX
        LD    B,A
mul1    ADD   HL,DE
        DJNZ  mul1
        ADD   HL,HL
        LD    A,H
        EXX
;END MUL
        INC   A
        LD    (DE),A
        INC   L
        INC   E
        JR    NZ,mdf_sin

        LD    LX,16
kd1     LD    B,#80
        LD    HL,#9000
        LD    DE,ncos
c1      LD    (HL),E
        INC   L
        JR    NZ,c1
kd2     LD    A,(DE)
        INC   E
        ADD   A,HX
        LD    L,A
        LD    A,B
        ADD   A,LX
        ADD   A,LX
        AND   #12
        JR    Z,kdec1
        DEC   (HL)
        JR    $+3
kdec1   INC   (HL)
        DJNZ  kd2

        LD    L,1
        LD    DE,#a010
        XOR   A
kd4     LD    (DE),A
        DEC   E
        JR    NZ,kd4
        LD    (DE),A
        LD    BC,#4080
kdout   BIT   7,(HL)
        JR    Z,kno1
        LD    A,(DE)
        OR    C
        LD    (DE),A
kno1    RRC   C
        JR    NC,$+3
        INC   E
        INC   L
        DJNZ  kdout
;PUT 2 MEMORY
        LD    A,8
kmem    LD    DE,#c000;PAGE
k2mem   LD    HL,#a000
        PUSH  HL
amplc   LD    C,8
        LDIR
;ROLL ONE LINE RIGHT
        LD    B,9
        POP   HL
rol0    OR    A
rol1    RR    (HL)
        INC   L
        DJNZ  rol1
        DEC   A
        JR    NZ,k2mem
        OUT   (#fe),A
        LD    (kmem+1),DE
        DEC   LX
        JR    NZ,kd1
        DEC   HX
        JP    P,kd0
;MAKE X TABLE
;MAKE ANGLE (SPR) TBL
        LD    B,#c0
        LD    DE,sin
        LD    L,E
mkxt1   LD    H,x_tbl&h
        LD    A,(DE)
        RRCA
        RRCA
        RRCA
        RRCA
        LD    C,A
        AND   #0f
        ADD   A,4
        LD    (HL),A
        INC   H
        LD    A,(DE)
        RLCA
        RLCA
        AND   #38
        LD    (HL),A
        INC   H
        LD    A,C
        AND   3
        OR    B
        LD    (HL),A
        INC   H
        LD    A,C
        AND   B
        LD    (HL),A
        INC   H
        LD    A,(DE)
        RRCA
        RRCA
        AND   #3c
        LD    (HL),A
        INC   L
        INC   E
        JR    NZ,mkxt1
        IM    1
        EI
hlt     HALT
        LD    (sp_prep+1),SP
        LD    SP,4*192+spc_tbl
i1      LD    A,0
ik1     ADD   A,mn1
        LD    (i1+1),A
        LD    LX,A
        EX    AF,AF
i3      LD    A,0
ik3     ADD   A,mn3
        LD    (i3+1),A
        LD    HX,A
i2      LD    A,0
ik2     ADD   A,mn2
        LD    (i2+1),A
        LD    L,A
        LD    BC,#08e0
        LD    D,#57
prep1   LD    H,x_tbl&h
        LD    A,(HL)
        INC   H
        OR    C
        LD    E,A
        PUSH  DE
        LD    A,(HL)
        INC   H
        EXX
        LD    C,A
        EXX
        LD    A,L
ik4     ADD   A,st1
        EX    AF,AF
        LD    A,LX
ik5     ADD   A,st2
        LD    LX,A
        LD    L,A
        LD    A,(HL)
        INC   H
        EXX
        LD    H,A
        EXX
        LD    A,(HL)
        INC   H
        EXX
        ADD   A,C
        LD    L,A
        EXX
        LD    A,HX
ik6     ADD   A,st3
        LD    HX,A
        LD    L,A
        LD    A,(HL)
        EXX
        ADD   A,H
        LD    H,A
        PUSH  HL
        EXX
        EX    AF,AF
        LD    L,A
        DEC   D
        DJNZ  prep1
        LD    B,8
        LD    A,C
        SUB   #20
        LD    C,A
        JR    C,prep0
        LD    A,D
        ADD   A,B
        LD    D,A
        JP    prep1
prep0   LD    A,D
        CP    #3f
        JR    NZ,prep1
sp_prep LD    SP,0
        HALT
kishka  LD    (sp_kshk+1),SP
        LD    SP,spc_tbl
        LD    B,192
        XOR   A
kishka1 POP   HL
        POP   DE
        LD    (DE),A
        INC   E
        LD    C,D
        !ASSM 8
        LDI
        !CONT
        LD    (DE),A
        DJNZ  kishka1
sp_kshk LD    SP,0
tmr     LD    A,0
        INC   A
        AND   #7f
        LD    (tmr+1),A
jrj     JP    NZ,hlt

hls     LD    HL,data
        LD    E,(HL)
        INC   HL
        LD    D,(HL)
        INC   HL
        LD    A,(HL)
        INC   HL
        LD    (hls+1),HL
        LD    (DE),A
        LD    A,E
        CP    #dd
        JR    NZ,jrj
rrr     POP   HL
        EXX
        RET

data    DEFW  ik2+1;KISHKA_START
        DEFB  #FD
        DEFW  ik4+1
        DEFB  #1
        DEFW  ik6+1;2K
        DEFB  #87
        DEFW  ik6+1
        DEFB  #FD
        DEFW  ik4+1
        DEFB  #56
        DEFW  ik2+1
        DEFB  #57
        DEFW  ik4+1
        DEFB  #57
        DEFW  ik6+1
        DEFB  #FC

        DEFB  #DD

______l EQU   $-start

sin     EQU   $&h+1*256
ncos    EQU   sin+#100
